title: Keep the delivery reason tooltip hoverable at transcript edges
outcome: The reason tooltip stays reachable by pointer when the transcript clips part of its trigger.
acceptance: When the transcript clips the top or bottom of a delivery reason trigger, a pointer can move directly from the visible part of that trigger into its tooltip without closing it.
Once the whole trigger is clipped, the tooltip closes and Escape reaches the conversation. A browser regression exercises partial and complete clipping.
